$comment: beetle repo manifest — machine-local, never committed to any repo.
Set BEETLE_REPOS in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored) to relocate per machine.
'path' supports ~ and $ENV expansion. 'url' should be the GitHub URL so courier summaries stay portable.
Mirrors the portable mcp.json artifact pattern from aichat integrated-architecture docs.
Supports a 'meta_repo' field to point to the meta repository for further context.
Consistency is enforced: if meta repository information contradicts the local repository, error loudly and flag to the user.
Note that if you adopt a meta-repo structure for multi-repo projects, you should set 'meta_repo' to the URL of the meta repository.
By design the meta repo should not have any machine-local configuration or secrets
